lines.en: : So, before we all part ways, I’d like to thank each and every one of you for not making dinner inherently miserable. That went way better than I would have expected. You two get along weirdly well.
: Me and Otoha have a lot in common actually! So much that I think she should move in too!
: Excuse me?
: In fact, why doesn’t everybody move in?! If we’re going to be allowing non-family into the place, we might as well stop excluding everybody else who wants to fuck my dad! The more, the merrier!
: Well, at least she waited until dinner was over.
: I feel like it would be an act against my character right now if I were to not clarify once more that I do not want to have sex with your dad.
: Oh, sorry. Is he too old?
: Anyway! I’ll be leaving now. But thanks for the food. And...trying to indoctrinate me into your family. Tonight was definitely everything I thought it was going to be and more.
: Don’t walk back alone, please. Ami will go with you.
: I beg your pardon?
: Akira and I have some adult things to do. Don’t we, Akira?
: Oh. Uhh...yeah. Like paying bills and other boring stuff that teenagers definitely shouldn’t be involved in because they’re not old enough.
: Great job, babe. They’re totally convinced now.
: Can we pay the bills doggy style tonight?
: Anyway! We’ll be leaving now! But thanks for coming and getting indoctrinated into our dysfunctional fucking family. Do not, under any circumstances, come to our house over the next twelve hours.
: We have so many bills.
: Akira, do you ever go to sleep at night proud of who you are?
: No.
: Good.
: I guess you and I can head back to the dorms then, Otoha?
: What, you’re not going to try and stop them? This is like the perfect opportunity for some sort of temper tantrum about how Niki will never love him the way you can.

: Meh. I have plenty of opportunities for that. I just think it’s important that Aunt Niki gets her space tonight so she never fully abandons the idea that there can be moments of comfort in this life!
: It’d be really boring if she just gave up!
: Ami, if I didn’t have so many bills to pay, I would ground you right now.
: Can you ground me doggy style at least?
: Does this family know any other positions or is that the only one?
: Maybe Niki can rescind her command that we leave her alone so we can all go back to my place and try out a bunch of new ones?
: On second thought, I think I might just go to sleep.
: Wait, Niki-
: Can’t hear you! Too busy not wanting to pay the bills anymore!
: Damn it, Ami. Look what you’ve done now.
: So remember a little earlier when I asked if you could take it easier on Niki and that she’s sort of falling apart?
: Yeah, why?
: Well, I just think that you should take it a little easier on Niki because she’s sort of falling apart.
: Oh, don’t worry. They’re still totally going to have sex. In fact, the two of them have even more sex whenever she’s angry. I think she does it as a coping mechanism.
: And Akira doesn’t?
: Well, it’s okay when he does it. He’s a boy.
: I have cameras if you want to watch. My dad tried to get rid of them all, but I hid one inside of some robot toy Io made for him and he doesn’t know about that one yet.
: How are you this fucking crazy, Ami? Like, you’ve never seemed normal on account of the whole...familial clinginess thing...but I didn’t think you were an actual psychopath.

: Psychopath? That’s harsh. And totally untrue too. Psychopaths are super antisocial and here I am walking home with a classmate who I’ve never really been alone with before. Sounds pretty social to me, Otoha.

: Well, if you’re looking for my stamp of approval just because I may or may not read your mom’s poetry, you’re not going to get it. I never knew any of that stuff was real. I thought she was just saying shit.
: She was at the end. But if you read any of that stuff, you probably wouldn’t be questioning why I am the way I am, now would you?
: How you are doesn’t really matter to me. I just don’t want you hurting the people I care about. That’s all.
: I don’t want to hurt anybody, Otoha. Plus, you’re best friends with Nodoka and she hurts people for her own benefit all the time.

: “Friends” isn’t really the first word I’d use to describe us. We’re more like...two misguided robots who fell out of a delivery truck and now exist to infinitely try and complete our respective missions.
: Yeah, and I’m the same way. There’s a thing I need to do and I’m going to do it no matter what obstacles appear before me.
: I guess it’s easier when I at least vaguely understand what Nodoka is trying to do.
: Which is what, exactly?
: That I don’t think I can say. Both because I don’t know if she’d want me to and because I’d probably suck at explaining it as a whole.
: It’s probably not what you think, though. Especially if you assume she’s only hurting people for her own benefit. Nodoka’s not like that, crazy as that sounds.
: But I am?

: I don’t know, Ami. But when I see someone I respect as much as Niki being essentially walked all over by a girl even smaller and younger than me, I can’t help but wish things were a little different.
: Which isn’t even touching on the stranglehold you have on Akira. You could cut that guy’s limbs off and he’d still refuse to give up on you. It’s just like how Niki is with him.
: Do you think you’ll ever love somebody that much, Otoha?
: Me? Why?
: It’s just, even when you were dating Rin, you seemed like you were just in it for the fun of everything.
: And I’ve heard that tons of people confessed to you at your old school. You’d think at least one of them would interest you, right?
: I...hope I can find someone that does one day? I don’t know. Nothing’s really clicked yet. And right now, the only person I’ve ever felt that way about-
: Just say her name. I know it’s Niki.
: Ooooooof course you do.
: For what it’s worth, I ship you guys together. A famous idol two-timing her childhood friend with the teenage girl she’s giving vocal lessons to? I’d read, like...a hundred volumes of that.
: Well, unfortunately for both of us, that’s just not in the cards.
: What if it could be, though?
: Whaaaat...are you implying exactly?
: Like, what if there was a world out there where you got what you wanted? That you and Niki wound up together. Wouldn’t you want to see it?
: I mean...obviously. But that’s not something I’m going to try and force into existence out of my own personal selfishness.
: Just wanting to be happy is selfish now?
: It is when it involves robbing other people of theirs.
: Well, that’s why I mentioned a different world. One where everybody gets their wish. And you can rest easy knowing you haven’t stolen anything from anybody.
: Then sure. In this made-up scenario where I can mysteriously swap worlds and get everything I want without hurting anyone, yes. I would gladly indulge myself in that.
: I’d need a lot more than the hot older girl I’m into to like me back in order to make me feel fulfilled, though.
: We can throw in a cute little brother or two if that makes you happy.
: I want to play at the Budokan as well. And have a single hit top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100.
: You could have the best-selling album of the year for all we know. I can’t see into your dreams.
: But if I could, I’d take you by the hand and force you to look at them. Like, really look at them. Because we take our dreams for granted sometimes. I know I did.
: And great things come from understanding what you can have if you just put your best foot forward. Things you’re more familiar with than you know.
: You’re a fucking weird girl, Ami. Like, what’s even the point of this weird, rhetorical rant?
: There are a few points, Otoha!
: The first is me trying to show you I’m not some evil super-villain who only exists to sow discord and make everyone you love unhappy.
: The second is to find out more about you.
: Why, though? We were practically strangers until a little while ago.
: Heh! We were, weren’t we? But still...
: I just needed to know you were you.
: Well, it’s been...
: Well, it’s definitely been.
: Anything planned for the rest of the night?
: Just writing. Maybe a shower. Instagram. Why?
: Just wondering.
: Also, why did you follow me up here? Your dorm is on the first floor. Your mission is complete. Go home.
: Do you want to, like...I don’t know...maybe hang out a little more?
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhh...whyyyyy?
: You sound a little...put-off by that.
: Sorry. I just wasn’t expecting it.

: We don’t have to if you feel weird about it. I just...don’t get many chances to talk to people about my mom’s poetry and...I figured sharing that with another fan might be kinda...I don’t know...fun, I guess?
: But you’re right. It’s weird. And I’m probably already annoying you, so-
: No, I’m...not annoyed. I just didn’t even think I was going out to dinner with you and Akira tonight and now it’s like I really am being indoctrinated into the Arakawa drama circle.

: I can avoid that sort of drama if you don’t like it. I just want to...learn more about what you like and share poems and stuff. I hear you’re really good. You know my dad used to write too, don’t you?
: I...yeah, I’ve...I’ve heard about that.
: Then...maybe just for a little while? I feel kind of weird in my dorm room when Maya isn’t there. Unless Nodoka would be opposed to me bothering you guys or something.
: Nodoka’s at her mom’s tonight, so...it’ll be just you and me if...that’s cool?
: Very cool! I-
: Shh! Io and Touka get pissed when people are making noise too late up here.
: Oh! Sorry, I...I’m really only ever up here to play D&D with Molly, so...
: It’s...fine. Just...hurry up and get inside before anybody sees us.
: You’re making it sound like we’re here to hook up.
: Then get inside at a reasonable pace at which no one will think I’m bringing you here for sexual purposes!
: Poor Rin. I wonder what she’d think if she saw us?
: Oh my fucking god, just get-
: Oh, wow! So this is what it’s like in here. I’ve always wondered.
: It’s...a room. That much is certainly...factual.
: You’ve got a lot of Bandori posters. Is Yukina your fav? That, like, totally tracks.
: Huh? Uhh...yeah. You...you’re into that too?

: I’ve got a PasuPare poster right next to my bed. I spent like half of my last paycheck on the new Aya UR. Roselia’s good too, though! I like Sayo the most in that group. She reminds me a little of Maya.

: Like, Makinami. Not to be confused with Maya from PasuPare. I just realized it was probably a little confusing mentioning real-life Maya in the same conversation I’m talking about the existence of a fake Maya.
: No, I...knew what you meant. That’s cool, though. I guess we do have some stuff in common after all.

: Oh, tons, I’m sure! Like, we both like Bandori. We both like Niki’s music. We both like The Girl Who Cannot Breathe. And we’d both totally go down on my dad if divine magic suddenly turned him into a little kid again!
: Wait one-
: How do you feel about parfaits? I can get you a free one if you come to the maid cafe during my next shift. I normally work-
: Ami! Chill. And cut it out with the fucking shotacon shit.
: Sorry. I’ll keep my voice down. So, what is it about them that you like? Fictionally, of course. Did you go to any of those sites I sent you?
: I...may have...clicked on a couple of them for...research purposes...
: You’re bi, right? Cause if you’re into loli stuff as well, I have a totally different site for that. If it’s just boys, I get it, though. Older sister fantasies are tough to contend with, huh?
: Ami, I really do not like this line of questioning if we’re being completely honest.
: Oh, sorry. I guess it’s probably weird to talk about this with somebody you’re not close to, huh? My bad. I’m just so used to doing it with Maya that I kinda forgot me and you weren’t as close yet.
: It’s fine, I-
: Wait, Maya? Really?

: Oh, God yeah. She’s not really into shotas, but she reads a ton of loli doujinshi. I think it’s a projection thing because she’s so small. I just like it because I like anything socially unacceptable.
: This is...good information that I will definitely not do anything with or about.
: So, like, sorry if this is rude and feel free to not answer if you don’t want to, but are you only uncomfortable talking about this stuff because it’s not all fiction to you?
: Like, I know what I said a few minutes ago, but would you or would you not actually get with some little boy if you knew you could? And how young would you go exactly? What’s the cut-off?
: I knew I should not have invited you in here.
: It’s so sad, right?! That some people have to go their whole lives without being able to do anything about their greatest desires?!
: Ami-

: Or they could be like my mom. And capitalize on those desires anyway because they’re far more nuanced than society thinks, right? Her greatest sin was loving the wrong person. How fair is that? Huh?
: Do you have a favorite poem of hers? I probably know it by heart if you do. Give me the first line and I’ll give you the rest.
: How would Akira feel hearing you talk about all of this, Ami?
: Depends on the light. He changes every day. Sometimes, he’d probably cry. Others? He’d probably close his eyes and wish he were right back in bed with her.
: They were in love and you know it. You want it. And you’ve always wanted something like that. But you feel guilty because the world tells you that’s not how you’re supposed to feel.
: Who cares, though? Why would you when there’s another world out there where everything is completely the opposite?
: Morals are decided by humans and humans are stupid. So why have we decided they’re all just right about this? How can just twenty-four hours separate a normal person from a pariah?
: This is all just my take, though. Like, I wouldn’t think any less of you if you did have a little brother you were bathing with every night for extended periods of time. You know?
: I don’t think I’ve ever felt this...I don’t know. Ashamed before?
: I don’t want to shame you, Otoha. I get it. It’s hard liking things the world decided you’re not allowed to like. We both grew up on that concept.
: All I did was read. It’s just...I’ve been talking so much shit on Akira from the start for the way he treats our class just to...be hiding something like this about myself.
: If he ever found out, I wouldn’t even be able to look at him anymore. Especially knowing that he’s the literal product of what happens when fiction stops being just fiction.
: Can I propose something super weird?
: I mean, you’re already fucking calling me out on everything else you’ve managed to pick up about me tonight. Why stop now?
: If you really want a little brother, you can treat me like one.
: I’m sorry. What?
: Think about it! You don’t have any siblings. I don’t have any siblings. You want to groom a little boy. I like power dynamics, age gaps, and illicit contact between family members.
: Plus, even training bras are too big for me sometimes!
: I’m basically already built like a little boy. Just throw a strap-on on me and I’m pretty much the perfect way for you to get what you want without feeling the wrath of society!
: Ami, aren’t you straight?
: Yeah, why?
: Because I’m a girl.
: Yeah, and I’d be the boy in this scenario. Did you miss that part?
: Holy shit. You did come in here to hook up with me.
: I mean, I figured it was possible. You don’t seem that excited, though. I thought this was a great idea.
: Right.
: Right.
: Like, seriously. There’s just nothing there. When are they supposed to start growing? Because I feel like it should have happened already.
: Yeah...uhh...
: I think I’m...gonna go make a phone call really quick.
: Otoha? Right now? Really?
: Yup. Just a quick one. Be back in a second.
: Well, what am I supposed to do?
: Don’t know. Be back shortly. Bye.
: Okay...
: You’re missing out, though. Because, between the washboard and the short hair, I really am just like the boys you’ve been fingering yourself to.
: And that’s not even touching on my acting skills.
: Wow. What a nice desk.
: It’d sure be terrible if somebody suddenly ruined everything both inside of and on top of it.
: Hi. It’s me. Come get your daughter before she turns into your son.
: You know, I expected a call from you, but those are not the words I anticipated hearing once I answered.
: She’s freaking me the fuck out, dude. Like, she not only knows certain shit about me that nobody but Nodoka knows, but the way she’s talking about it makes me think she’s even crazier than you are.
: That’s my girl, alright.
: And you’re just totally fine with that?
: Absolutely not. But if you think there’s anything I can do about her, you’re wrong. I’m at my wit’s end, Otoha. Here’s Niki.
: No, I don’t want to talk to Niki. I-
: Otoha? What did that fucking parasite do now? And make it quick. I’m trying to pay my bills.
: Hah...nothing, Niki. Everything’s totally a-okay over here and you can go back to your finances without having to worry about it. I’ve got it under control.
: Are you sure? Because I dragged you into this. Which means I can try to drag you out but that it probably won’t work because, like Akira said, nothing will work and I’m at my wit’s end too.
: Yup. I’ve got it. See you next weekend.
: Oh, maybe just try acting like an older sister or something? That’s what Noriko tries to do, but Noriko’s fed up with her now too.
: I feel like that is the actual worst thing I could do in this case. Good-
: AAAH! YOU FUCKING...WARN ME FIRST, ASSHOLE!
: Night...
: Ami?
: Sorry, but I think it’s time you-
: Oh.
: Yup.
: Should have known that was a bad idea.
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
Niki’s lust has increased to [niki_lust]!
